identity.silhouette: Horizon-scale knot of roads rising into the sky like limbs.
identity.lore_hook: Every road is said to lead somewhere; hers lead back into herself.

signature: Road Arms create moving traversal paths.
Wrong Turn teleports players only between authored intersection pairs.
Toll Guardians control shortcuts.
Central Roundabout becomes final arena after enough routes are severed.
counterplay: Map routes, capture shortcuts, and avoid fighting on collapsing lanes.
evolution: Upgrades alter behavior, timing, or spatial control rather than relying on flat stat multipliers.

vfx: Roads glow as elevated ribbons.
Intersections pulse before relocation.
Central roundabout rises like a crown.
Mother of Roads adds a unique readable VFX layer for its 4th state, with distance-scaled fallback.
animation: Entire road segments bend in slow arcs.
Roundabout spins during final phase.
Mother of Roads uses a bespoke 3th state-transition animation with protected anticipation frames.

entities.name: Emperor of Second Suns

identity.fantasy: An Absolute emperor who creates a second local sun and forces players to manage two moving shadow systems.
identity.silhouette: Colossal white-black ruler with two suns orbiting the arena.
identity.lore_hook: One sun reveals truth; the other reveals what truth costs.

signature: First Sun exposes real weak points.
Second Sun exposes false-but-dangerous shadow entities.
Solar Alignment creates a brief safe eclipse lane.
Twin Noon removes all shadows and forces movement between heat shelters.
Sun Theft lets a player temporarily carry one sun fragment to reposition light.
counterplay: Coordinate light carriers and attack only under correct sun state.
evolution: Upgrades alter behavior, timing, or spatial control rather than relying on flat stat multipliers.

vfx: Two distinct suns cast crossed shadows.
Alignment draws a perfect black-gold line.
Carried sun fragment lights player like a comet.
Twin Noon bleaches local color.
Weak points change under each sun.
animation: Emperor gestures and suns physically orbit.
Sun Theft tears a fragment from sky.
Alignment pose locks both arms opposite each other.
Final eclipse kneel lowers both suns.

entities.name: The Name Before Zero

identity.fantasy: A Transcendent trial manifestation that strips titles, rarity labels, and borrowed power presentation until only mastery-driven mechanics remain.
identity.silhouette: Human-scale black silhouette surrounded by erased UI fragments.
identity.lore_hook: Every candidate arrives with a name. The trial asks whether anything remains when the name is removed.

signature: Erases cosmetic rarity presentation.
Suppresses selected borrowed encounter buffs.
Cycles through movement, support, precision, survival, and command tests.
Scores mechanic accuracy rather than raw damage.
Failure state returns player without consuming permanent progression.
Final Nameless Phase gives one simple attack pattern and demands perfect execution.
counterplay: Deterministic trial with explicit telegraphs and no pay-to-skip path.
evolution: Upgrades alter behavior, timing, or spatial control rather than relying on flat stat multipliers.

vfx: UI labels fade into black strips.
Borrowed buffs appear as sealed icons.
Each mastery test uses one stark geometric color.
Final phase removes all background VFX.
Success writes the player's chosen title back into the scene.
Failure reseals the arena without spectacle.
animation: Boss shifts stance to match each mastery test.
Buff suppression uses a clean seal gesture.
Final phase holds an almost motionless duelist stance.
Success bows once before dissolving.
Failure simply turns away.
audio: Distinct The Name Before Zero activation, impact, danger, and cooldown motifs with positional falloff.

method: Only after all Zero Candidate prerequisites and before the Choosing.
